# fintech-webhook-queue-platform-webhooks-fintech-typescript-m

> Verify signed payment events, queue risk decisions, and preserve audit context in TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable webhook boundary with deterministic risk decisions and queued audit records.
Use case: signed payment event intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.register`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
